# Vietnam Visa Requirements for US Citizens

US citizens traveling to Vietnam for tourism, including stays less than 30 days, are generally required to obtain a visa prior to arrival. The most common and convenient option for short tourist stays is the e-visa.

## Key Information for Tourist Visas (Under 30 Days)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/passport.svg

-   **Visa Requirement**: US citizens must obtain a valid visa to enter Vietnam, even for short tourist visits. There is no visa exemption for US citizens.
-   **E-Visa Option**: For tourism, the Vietnamese e-visa is widely available and suitable for stays up to 90 days, including single and multiple entries. This covers visits shorter than 30 days.
-   **Validity**: An e-visa typically allows a stay of up to 90 days from the specified entry date. Ensure your intended stay falls within this period.
-   **Required Documents (for E-visa)**:
    -   A scanned copy of your passport bio-page (must be valid for at least six months beyond your intended entry date).
    -   A recent passport-style digital photo (plain white background, no glasses, no head covering).
    -   Details of your planned entry and exit dates.
    -   Proposed entry and exit checkpoints (airports, land borders, seaports).

## Application Process & Important Notes

-   **Application Portal**: Applications for the e-visa are submitted online through the official Vietnam Immigration Department website.
-   **Processing Time**: Standard processing typically takes 3-5 working days, but it's advisable to apply at least 1-2 weeks before your travel date to account for any unforeseen delays.
-   **Passport Validity**: Your passport must be valid for at least six months beyond your planned date of entry into Vietnam.
-   **Print E-visa**: After approval, you must print out your e-visa to present upon arrival. Digital copies on a phone are generally not sufficient.
-   **Entry/Exit Points**: Ensure the entry and exit points chosen during your e-visa application match your actual travel plans.

## Quick Actions
-   [Apply for Vietnam E-visa]: https://evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn/
-   [US Dept. of State Travel Advisory for Vietnam]: https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/International-Travel-Country-Information-Pages/Vietnam.html

## Sources
-   Vietnam Immigration Department: https://evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn/
-   U.S. Department of State: https://travel.state.gov/
